data: Four corpora with existing hashes in research/detector/sources.json: KFUPM academic-ar.jsonl, Ar-APT apt-human-polished.json, Liang TOEFL GPT4 polished with original in prompt, Hewlett student essays simplified with original in prompt. Source is explicitly paired, no imputation by position.
selection: 64 unique original documents per cohort, lowest SHA-256 in UTF-8 order; use excerpts up to 300 words of each original and rewrite. Deduplicate on normalized source and exclude identical or empty source/rewrite. For each case compare 8 distinct original sources in same cohort, selecting seven distractors at fixed offsets from source hash rank.
metrics: Which source is ranked first by number of covered words then sum of word-weighted match score? Ties or no hits count as misses. Compute coverage of words attributable to the correct source. No known passage-level boundaries, no false-positive claim.
analysis: The engine version is frozen. Report all results, including decreases. Data were not used to fit or promote the similarity system. Upstream corpora were used separately for authorship research.
